newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police investigate necrophilia case.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police investigate necrophilia case.

text.p: Belgian police are questioning a 59-year-old suspected necrophiliac paedophile alleged to have been digging up corpses of children and taking pictures of them for nearly 40 years, a court spokesman said on Thursday.
"We are investigating the case," the spokesman said. He declined to comment further.

Newspapers said police had seized more than 1,000 pictures of different dead children and had dredged wells and a septic tank behind the man's antique shop in the northern port city of Antwerp on Wednesday to see if they held bodies.
The pictures were taken in hospitals, morgues and cemeteries, press reports said. Some bodies had been completely dug up while others were pictured in their graves.

Belgium is currently in shock over the unmasking of a child abduction, sexual abuse and murder ring allegedly led by a convicted child rapist, which has prompted unprecedented questions about the moral and political health of the country.
